displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Bryant 926TB: short flashes, then long flashes. Code 14 is 1 short flash and 4 long flashes
meaning: Ignition lockout. The system failed to ignite gas and prove flame in 4 attempts. The control auto-resets after 3 hours. The manual says to see status code 34.
causes: Gas did not ignite and flame was not proved in 4 attempts
diySteps: Count 1 short flash and 4 long flashes. The same manual's sequence says the hot-surface igniter warms up for 17 seconds, then a 2-second flame-proving window follows. Failed trials repeat, then the control goes to ignition lockout
The sequence says lockout resets after three hours, or when 115 V or 24 V power to the control is interrupted. Resetting is not a repair
The sequence also says the furnace control must be grounded or it will lock out
Technician: follow status code 34, which code 14 points to
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 14 returns after the 3-hour reset. Do not jumper the gas valve.
